tools.name: atrib-verify
tools.description: Verify counterparty handoff evidence before linking follow-up work through informed_by. Legacy alias: new callers should prefer the `recall` tool's `verification` parameter.

packet.description: Private continuation or handoff packet carrying records, proof bundles, local mirror sidecars, and optional trust policy.

records.description: Evidence entries, usually parsed D062 local mirror envelopes or packet records. Used when packet is omitted.

claims.description: Alias for records. Each entry can be a bare AtribRecord or an envelope with record, proof, and _local sidecar.

required_record_hashes.description: Record hashes the receiving agent expected. Missing entries are preserved as verifier rejections.

trusted_creator_keys.description: Allowed creator_key values for upstream records. When set, records from other signers are rejected.

allowed_context_ids.description: Allowed upstream context_id values. When set, records from other contexts are rejected.

require_body.description: Require private body material from body, args/result, or D062 _local content.

require_body_commitment.description: Require args_hash or result_hash on the signed record so private body material can be checked.

require_log_inclusion.description: Require a supplied proof bundle whose inclusion path verifies against the checkpoint root.

log_public_key_b64.description: Optional trusted log Ed25519 public key, base64 or base64url encoded. When supplied, checkpoint signatures are verified.

now_ms.description: Verifier wall-clock override in milliseconds. Mostly for deterministic tests.

max_age_ms.description: Freshness window. Records older than this, or dated in the future, are rejected as stale.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Look up the agent's signed past: atrib's read verb. One read-only tool absorbs the legacy recall_* tools (shape argument), trace / trace_forward (shape=walk with a direction), and atrib-verify (the verification parameter). Results are JSON-identical to the legacy tool they map onto; every compact result keeps record_hash so calls can be chained. Signs nothing.

shape.description: Which read shape to run. Required unless `verification` is supplied (verification-only call). history = filter-and-page over the local mirror; walk = graph/causal walk from `start`; content = BM25 free-form retrieval over `query`; chain = chronological session chain; annotations / revisions = per-record aggregations from `start`; orphans = loose-end discovery; by_signer = per-creator aggregation; state = current heads of signed revision lineages without arbitrary conflict resolution.

direction.description: Walk only. Omit for the local derived-graph walk (legacy recall_walk). 'backward' walks the informed_by chain that led to `start` (legacy trace); 'forward' walks the records that cited `start` (legacy trace_forward).

start.description: 'sha256:<64-hex>' starting record_hash. REQUIRED for walk, annotations, and revisions.

query.description: Free-form BM25 content query per D086. REQUIRED for shape=content.

filters.description: AND-combined filters. Which fields apply depends on the shape; see each field.

context_id.description: 32-hex context_id filter (history, chain, orphans; walk trace scoping).

context_scope.description: History only. How to treat an omitted context_id: 'all' (default) searches cross-context; 'env' applies the D078/D083 env-derived current context.

event_type.description: Event-kind filter: shorthand alias or full URI (history, orphans).

topic_tags.description: History only. OR-match against annotation topic tags.

include_revised.description: History only. Hide records superseded by a revision when true.

min_signers.description: History only. Minimum count of distinct signers.

rank_by.description: History only. Result ordering; same semantics as the legacy tool.

rank_anchor.description: History only. Anchor for non-timestamp rank_by modes.

limit.description: Page size / top-k. history: default 10, max 200. content: top-k, default 10, max 50. chain and orphans: default 50, max 500.

offset.description: History only. Pagination offset (explicit handle; never protocol-session state).

compact.description: history and walk-with-direction: omit heavy record fields (default true).

include_unverified.description: History only. Include records that failed local signature verification.

toc.description: History only. Table-of-contents entry shape per record.

edge_types.description: Walk (no direction) only. Layer 1 edge types to follow; default all four.

depth.description: Walk only. Maximum hop count. Graph walk default 3; directional walks default 3, max 10.

max_nodes.description: Walk with direction only. Hard cap on visited records (default 200, max 500).

include_content.description: chain and walk-with-direction: include the D062 local mirror body per record.

max_records.description: Content only. Maximum newest-first records to search before candidate scoring.

evidence_mode.description: Content only. Coverage posture; same semantics as the legacy tool (D123/D125).

include_tool_call_args.description: Content only. Lift the operational tool_call score suppression (D156).

min_records.description: by_signer only. Minimum record count to include a creator.

root_record_hashes.description: State only. Project these lineage roots. Omit to discover every verified revision root.

trusted_creator_keys.description: State only. Accept records from these creator keys. Omit only for a local all-signers view.

allowed_context_ids.description: State only. Accept records from these contexts. Omit for a cross-context view.

head_limit.description: State only. Maximum active heads returned per lineage cell. The projector reports truncation and the total head count.

verification.description: Run handoff-evidence verification (legacy atrib-verify) and attach the tiered result as a `verification` block on the response. When the optional @atrib/verify peer is not installed, the block is { status: "verifier_unavailable" } and the read result is unaffected (§5.8). Supply without `shape` for a verification-only call.
